data.narrative:
Bravo Ordnance is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $3.6M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies spanning Series A and Seed rounds, including Stark Defence ($4.0B), UFORCE ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The broader comp universe includes 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, with prominent peers including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Two valuation methods triangulate to a range. Stage-Progression applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier to the $3.6M raised proxy, implying $9M as Bravo progresses toward Series A. Peer-Median anchors to the median valuation of the four-company peer set at $700M, reflecting the wide dispersion in Defense & Security valuations ($125M to $4.0B).

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $8M to $805M, with a median of $354M. This wide range reflects structural uncertainty: the Stage-Progression method suggests near-term post-Seed valuation around $9M, while Peer-Median suggests substantially higher valuations are achievable within the sector. Key variables include Bravo's technical differentiation relative to better-funded peers, customer traction, and macroeconomic appetite for frontier defense technologies.
